extracted.intended_audience: journalists, editors, newswires and PR professionals preparing copy to Reuters style
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from the Reuters Handbook style guide: an indexed list of style topics and word-usage entries used to shape Reuters-style press releases and news copy. This chunk contains only the index/heading lines (topics listed) rather than the substantive guidance for each item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index of Reuters style topics (headings only)
rubrics_metrics.description: This page is an index/listing of style and usage topics (headings) such as 'Centigrade', 'CEO', 'commas', 'company names', 'data', 'departure/defence', 'communique', etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The chunk contains only the table-of-contents/index entries (topic titles) with no surrounding explanatory guidance. To apply these as style rules for press releases, consult the full Reuters Handbook entries corresponding to each heading (not present in this chunk).
